segments.text: Miyabi is a distant girl who stays away from the crowds and likes to be alone.
However, she occasionally goes out with Saki but does not participate in her group activities.
When she hears that Yuuki wants to run away from the school, she starts becoming interested in him and wants to talk more often with him, to the greatest surprise (and jealousy) of her classmates.
Miyabi is interested in Yuuki because she too is looking for a way to get out of school to ask her parents for a very important favor in relation to her future career path, becoming a pâtissière.

In her route, Miyabi and Yuuki exchange their "rings" to make others think they are going out together and also avoid attract the professors' suspicion since they need to spend a lot of time together planning their escape.

One of Yuuki's juniors. She is very kind.

Yuuki saved her when she had problems with some bad boys. Ever since that she sees Yuuki as her superhero and wants him to accept her "ring". She also tells him she had never fallen in love and dated a boy before. Sometimes she says in public that her senpai is her first time, creating rumors and confusion around her.

Even if she uses honorifics for all of her elders, Yuuki is the only one she calls just "Senpai~♪". She is deeply in love with Yuuki and she takes every opportunity to spend as much time as possible with him. Although she is afraid of being rejected, she doesn't hesitate to confess her love to him.
She is the youngest of her family and has an elder sister and two elder brothers.

Kotoko is the student council president of the school and also the senpai of Yuuki. Even if she looks serious, she's also very childish. She likes being called "Kotoko-senpai" by her juniors. One of her hobbies is massaging Yuumi's breasts, and Kotoko also loves teasing other people.
Like the majority of the students, she knows Yuuki because of his "incident" with Aya-sensei.

In Kotoko's route, after teasing Yuuki too much about his unrequired love for Aya-sensei, he gives his "ring" to her. She accepts it and tells him that it will surely make Aya-sensei jealous if she actually loves him.

Despite her popularity, a lot of the boys in their school do not dare give their "ring" to Kotoko because, according to the rumors, giving it away is a very serious gesture. According to the same rumors Kotoko has never accepted a "ring" before which is wrong, because she already accepted "rings" of several boys in the past. However, Kotoko always got bored of them after going on dates with them, so she never accepted their feelings.

In reality, Kotoko is insensitive to love and doesn't understand how it manifests itself. One time a boy she was dating offered her a beautiful necklace and she gave it back thinking that the "ring" was already enough. The boy ran away in tears, and she still doesn't know why.

Yuumi is the secretary of the student council. She's very pretty and is always sexually harassed by the president of the council, Kotoko, who really likes the softness of her breasts.
She is a pretty traditional girl, very polite and has very good manners. She is considered as the second prettiest girl of the academy, right after Aya-sensei.
She's very shy with boys, and finds it very difficult to talk with them because she suffers from androphobia.
Although she is shy and is afraid of boys and has never given her "ring" to another, she has on her arm a beautiful collection of "rings" she received as proof of confession.
She knows Yuuki because of his "incident" with Aya-sensei.
Yuumi's androphobia dates back a long time and finds its origin in her childhood. Ten years ago, Yuumi wore short hair and put loose clothes to run and climb trees.
All the boys made fun of her and stopped playing with her because she was, for them, all but not a girl.
The only one who never made fun of her and who continued to play with her until she moved with her parents to another city was Yuuki. At that time, she was secretly in love with him.
She is also a childhood friend of Aya, whom she considers as her big sister.

Saki is one of Yuuki's classmates and the first girl to talk to her. She talks to him because she is curious about his "incident" with Aya-sensei.
Saki is quite shameless because she doesn't hesitate to immediately call people by their first names and to give them nicknames.
Apparently, she tries since the beginning of the year to make Miyabi, her best friend, enter her "band of friends" because she is pretty and she could attract boys with said beauty.

The majority of her boys friends do not really see her as a girl but as a super friend with whom they can talk about pretty much anything. As a result, Saki is more of a matchmaker who helps her friends find lovers.

In order to respect the rules of the school and avoid expulsion, she sometimes went on a date with her friend Narumi. She now prefers to have Yuuki as partner but continues seeing Narumi sometimes in private.
She has a small collection of adult magazines and videos, to satisfy her needs, which she sometimes shares with Miyabi.

She comes from a noble family from her mother side but because her grandfather didn't want her mother and father - who came from a poor family - to get married, they fled away to create their own family.

Her mother spends her days in the hospital due to her health, and Saki is quite anxious because her condition isn't getting any better. Due to this, Saki wants to move and be transferred to a school closer to the hospital.
学園の2年生。
元気で明るく、世話焼きでちょっと食いしん坊なクラスメイト。
学園内のことや人、近所の美味しいお店など、色々なことに詳しい。
「ねーねー、新しくできたケーキ屋があるんだけど、ボクと一緒に行かない？」
Aya is the childhood friend of Yuuki
and Yuumi
and a teacher at Renai Gakuen, she is 5 years older than Yuuki.
Now a woman, she didn't recognize Yuuki because, he too, is now a magnificent man and is no longer a boy.
All the boys in the school thinks that Aya is the prettiest woman of the school because she has huge boobs.
After a few days, Yuuki confesses his love to her again but she rejects him because she likes him like a little brother and because a teacher and a student can't have a romantic relationship.
She often used to console Yuumi when she was young because the boys were always making fun of her, she considered her as her little sister ( and it's still the case ).

When she was a student at Renai Gakuen, the rules about love relationship were more stricts than now. The students had the obligation to go out together, under the penalty of expulsion if they didn't do so.

Aya, at that time, was like Yuuki, she wasn't interested in falling in love. After a few months, she decided to join the student council and it was at this moment that she met Ayuki, who helped her to stay in this school because she too was not very interested in falling in love.
Thanks to some trickery and with the help of Utsumi-sensei they were able to finish their schooling at Renai Gakuen.
Four years later, Aya was contacted by the school principal to become a teacher so that she could help students who are in the same situation as she was in the past.
The Protagonist of the game. Beautiful boy, he never really was interested about girls in a romantic way. Because of his parents and his past experience, he is disgusted by Love.
Despite years gone by, he still thinks of his childhood friend Aya-nee and wonders what happened to her.
When he learns that he will integrate a special school to find love, he has only one desire, it's leaving.

As soon as he arrives, he sees lovers everywhere. He now wants to teleport away from this place for morons. At the moment of leaving, he jostles a very pretty woman and falls with her. In his fall, he "un"lucky catches the bulky breast of the young woman. While he apologizes and ask to the lady if she is fine, he is shocked because he recognizes Aya-nee, who has now become a teacher.
Full of hope, he finally decides to follow her, in which will be today, his new classroom.

Yuuki will want to confess his feelings to her and that he wants to become her boyfriend but will not do it right after they had sex because of certain circumstances, waiting for the right moment.
Aya-nee was a very close friend of Yuuki, loving him as if he was her own little brother.
The day when she graduated from high school, Yuuki confessed to her but she gently rejected him, telling him to wait and start again when he grew up if he still had the same feelings.
After that day, she disappeared from Yuuki's life, but only because her graduate studies were outside the city.
